C-NET-STACK-BUMP.Summary: Move the locked Rust net stack two transitive crates forward — rustls-webpki 0.103.15 → 0.103.16 and h2 0.4.14 → 0.4.16 — through lockfile-only precise updates, with --locked check/test green, a lock diff containing exactly the intended moves (plus any resolver-forced transitive adjustments, listed and justified), a mechanical NOTICES-rust.md refresh and no reqwest/tokio or manifest change.
C-NET-STACK-BUMP.Problem: The dependency audit flags the locked net stack as lagging: the workspace Cargo.lock pins rustls-webpki 0.103.15 and h2 0.4.14. Both crates are transitive — neither appears in the workspace root Cargo.toml (which contains only the `[workspace]` table with member src-tauri) nor in src-tauri/Cargo.toml, and no `[patch]` section exists in either manifest. The inverse graph: rustls-webpki is pulled by rustls 0.23.46 and rustls-platform-verifier 0.7.0; h2 is pulled by hyper 1.10.1 and reqwest 0.13.5 (reqwest is the direct dep `reqwest = { version = "0.13", features = ["json"] }`). The affected runtime paths are the m016 updater signed-feed check (via tauri-plugin-updater's reqwest client), the m068 rollback update fetch (`reqwest::get`, src-tauri/src/m068_rollback.rs:965), the m045 extension discovery/invoke HTTP clients (reqwest with `redirect::Policy::none`), TLS certificate verification through rustls/webpki (notably the Linux TLS path) and HTTP/2 handling on every request those paths make. No vulnerability is claimed by this specification; it is a targeted maintenance bump of two point releases.
C-NET-STACK-BUMP.Relationship: Dependency maintenance on the existing net modules; it changes no behavior, contract or policy decision of C-UPDATER-ROLLBACK (M-068), C-SEC-AUDIT-FIXES or the m045 extension boundary and does not reopen any of them. Composed against the current beta-gate-wave worktree; the plan must re-verify lock versions on the fresh head before approval.

Goals.Goal: Cargo.lock pins rustls-webpki 0.103.16 (with its checksum updated accordingly) and h2 0.4.16, achieved by precise lockfile updates of these two packages only.
Offline locked builds and the existing Rust test suites stay green: cargo check/test with --locked succeed without regenerating the lockfile.

The lock diff contains exactly the two intended package moves plus any resolver-forced transitive adjustments; every forced move is enumerated and justified in the change bundle, or the diff is exactly two entries.
Attribution records stay consistent: NOTICES-rust.md is regenerated so its h2 and rustls-webpki rows name the new versions, keeping tools/verify-attributions.sh green.

Constraints.Constraint: Lockfile-only mechanism: `cargo update -p rustls-webpki --precise 0.103.16` and `cargo update -p h2 --precise 0.4.16` (run from the workspace root whose Cargo.lock this repository keeps; the suites use `--manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`). No direct dependency is added, no `[patch]` section is introduced and no Cargo.toml changes: both crates are transitive semver-compatible point releases inside the existing caret requirements of rustls 0.23.46 / rustls-platform-verifier 0.7.0 and hyper 1.10.1 / reqwest 0.13.5, so a manifest edit is neither necessary nor allowed by this change.

No other crate moves unless forced by the resolver. reqwest 0.13.5, tokio 1.54.1, hyper 1.10.1, hyper-util 0.1.20, rustls 0.23.46, rustls-pki-types 1.14.1 and tokio-rustls 0.26.4 stay at their current pinned versions; a broad `cargo update` is prohibited. If 0.103.16/0.4.16 force a transitive move (for example a shared dependency like bytes or rustls-pki-types), the forced entries are listed individually with the forcing reason in the change bundle.

No runtime behavior change: the m016 updater feed check, the m068 rollback fetch/promote flow, the m045 extension discovery/invoke redirect-none clients and the app-store/non-app-store feature split are untouched; no source file under src-tauri/src changes.

The NOTICES-rust.md refresh is a mechanical consequence of the attribution gate (the generator output embeds crate versions, and the current file names h2 0.4.14 and rustls-webpki 0.103.15); it is refreshed via tools/verify-attributions.sh --refresh and its diff may contain only the affected version rows.

Graph markup changes only where it states dependency facts: a SummaryDelta on the owning net modules in .grace/graph/features.xml may record the bumped versions; no ownership, contract, verification or acceptance markup is rewritten, and frozen archived bundles stay immutable.

No release, tag, app-version, signing or workflow change is authorized by this change. The Windows-only `cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))` rollback_restore fetch tests remain out of host scope and are neither enabled nor weakened.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No reqwest, tokio, hyper, rustls, rustls-pki-types or tauri-plugin-updater upgrade; the two target crates move to their pinned point releases and nothing else rides along.
No manifest restructuring: no direct dependency addition for rustls-webpki or h2, no `[patch]` section, no workspace Cargo.toml change, no feature flag change.
No updater, rollback or extension behavior change: no retry/timeout/protocol adjustments, no new tests asserting network behavior, no live-network test introduction.
No renderer, npm-side or QuickLook dependency change; no release or version change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The lock diff contains exactly the two intended moves — the `[[package]]` entries for rustls-webpki (0.103.15 → 0.103.16) and h2 (0.4.14 → 0.4.16) with their checksums — plus only resolver-forced entries, each individually listed and justified; otherwise the diff is exactly these two entries.

`cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked` and `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked` (workspace suites) succeed without lockfile regeneration; `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings` stays green.

The net-path suites stay green offline: `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --bin mark m068_rollback::` (the V-M-068 65-test suite as measured in verification evidence) and `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --bin mark m045_ext` pass unchanged, and the m016 updater unit suite passes with the same filter as current-state evidence.
NOTICES-rust.md regenerates clean: its diff shows only the h2 and rustls-webpki version rows, and ./tools/verify-attributions.sh (read-only diff mode) passes.
The .grace/graph/features.xml delta is limited to the declared SummaryDelta dependency-fact notes; grace lint passes before and after (current assertions pre-edit, target/final for the change).

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The plan records the pre-edit lock rows (rustls-webpki 0.103.15, h2 0.4.14), the post-edit `git diff Cargo.lock` showing exactly the intended moves (+justified forced entries), the green locked check/clippy/test output for the net suites, and the verify-attributions diff limited to the two version rows. No unit-level live-network fetch test exists for the macOS host (the three rollback_restore fetch tests are cfg-gated to non-macOS); locked check+clippy plus the m068_rollback/m045_ext/m016 suites are therefore the verification of record. A plan binds these before approval.

Assumptions.Assumption: rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and h2 0.4.16 are semver-compatible point releases satisfying the existing requirements of their parents in the lock, so precise lock updates need no manifest change; if the resolver proves otherwise, the spec's constraint requires the forced moves to be listed and justified rather than silently widened.

The crates are correctly identified as transitive (verified against both manifests and the lock's inverse references); the proportionally small scope — lockfile, notices, one graph note — reflects that finding.
Writing this draft approves no plan, implementation, apply/archive or release.
